block.rationale: Fresh verification block (latest at capture). KPK DAO holds 269.79 of 269.84 total KPK_ETH_Term shares (~99.98%) — a stable, material supply position. The eVault lends deposits out, so maxRedeem (~29.9 shares / ~30 WETH) is far below the full balance; the adapter reports the full convertToAssets value (NAV semantics), and the test redeems only the cash-available portion for the real-money cross-check. Re-fork to this exact block (or refresh and re-pin) before any live dashboard cross-check vs Debank / the Euler app.

kpk_RWA_USDC.note: Verified two ways: (1) test_realUsdcHolder_kpkFoundation reads the real KPK Foundation position (amount == convertToAssets(shares)); (2) the aggregation/NAV-routing tests deposit 2,000 USDC on KPK DAO's behalf so a single SAFE holds both legs. Real EulerEarn vault — direct ERC4626 deposit works on the fork.

vault_type: Both KPK instances are EulerEarn aggregator vaults (MetaMorpho fork: curator/guardian/supplyQueue), not core eVaults. KPK supplies only — no EVC controllers enabled on-chain. The adapter also handles core eVaults (Lend/Borrow): see case 2 below.

identity.positionId: abi.encode(address vault) — shared by both legs
identity.note: Up to two legs per vault. Supply via convertToAssets(balanceOf) for EulerEarn earn + core-eVault lend/collateral. Borrow via debtOf(account) for core eVaults (read under try/catch; EulerEarn lacks it). EVC-collateral supply is reported as Supplied (value identical; not labelled Collateral).
